# Monsters Encyclopedia

## Creature Types

| Type | Description | Immunities |
|------|-------------|------------------|
| Aberration | Mad otherworldly | Psychic |
| Beast | Natural animal | - |
| Construct | Artificial | Poison, necrotic |
| Dragon | Ancient reptile | Fire, cold, etc. |
| Elemental | Elemental being | Variable |
| Fey | Fairy creature | - |
| Fiend | Demon/devil | Fire (usually) |
| Giant | Large humanoid | - |
| Humanoid | Standard races | - |
| Monstrosity | Unnatural beast | - |
| Ooze | Amorphous | Slashing, piercing |
| Plant | Vegetable | - |
| Undead | Dead returned | Necrotic |
